CORE ARCHITECTURE

Engineered for Enterprise Intelligence

Six foundational pillars that make Flow the most secure, capable, and autonomous workflow engine for mission-critical operations.

Context Awareness

Flow builds a real-time knowledge graph of your work — learning relationships between CRM data, emails, documents, and spreadsheets across every application.

Workflow Engine
